name: hd_fs30_v2_pilotD
notes: PILOT D (docs/FS_PILOT.md): identical to pilot C (same 8 initial points = seed-31 draws of hd_fs30, same 30-iteration step-size-only warmup, 8 vectorised chains, fast exact likelihood) except the fixed metric is DENSE (hd_fs30's pooled z-covariance, as the M2 HD runs) instead of its diagonal. Pilot C (diagonal) was aborted under its rule: its warmup iterations 4-13 cost 255-1023 lockstep leapfrog steps (41-164 s each), projecting ~42 min for 30 warmup iterations. D measures the diagonal-vs-dense cost directly and, if it fits, post-warmup transition rates and ESS per gradient with 8 chains. NOT independent of hd_fs30. Abort rule (fixed before launch): abort if the 30 warmup iterations take > 20 min; stop at the last 25-draw checkpoint ending before 12:53 UTC on 2026-10-08 (2.5 h total pilot GPU time).
